items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: actually Trane played with Lin Holt. And that was great. I got that gig with him just for a little while.

ctx.x: And Rashied, I know you’re happy, right now you’ve got your own quartet, is that right?

Quintet actually, yeah. So you know, I have had many quintets since Coltrane’s days, and this is, the one I have now is the most workingist one of all, because the other quartets, the quintets, whatever, trios, that I had since Coltrane, it was just that I was never, you know I’m not really good at hustling gigs on my own. So and I’ve never really had an agent before, maybe since five years ago now. So I’ve never really got a lot of work. So I really couldn’t keep a band together very long without keeping them…
What’s a good month for you, as far as your band, as far as gigs?
